archimate:CourseOfAction.name: 10. Transforming People / HR system
archimate:CourseOfAction.documentation:
Transforming how our people function supports colleagues, using new technology to make everyday HR tasks simpler.​
Priority for pre-Christmas design work but opportunity to refine across January / March. Requirements needed to support effective evaluation of the correct ERP platform, however go-live currently expected to be later than Finance in 2028.
Level 2 capabilities are: Human resources​ Strategic prioritisation and triage​ Pipeline development ​ Operations oversight ​
